proof_id_hash.description: Identifier hash of the proof that was revoked.

revoked_at.description: Ledger timestamp at which the proof became invalid on-chain.

revoked_ledger.description: Ledger sequence at which the proof became invalid on-chain.

by_admin.description: True when the registry admin revoked the proof, false when the issuing party did.

epoch.description: Registry epoch after this revocation committed.

description: Emitted once when a proof is revoked, with the effective revocation timing and registry epoch.
